summary_md: **Arky Yang ([@arkyyang](https://x.com/arkyyang/status/2115441302569673003))** explains **When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory**: finding the corrected fact is not enough if the outdated version is also retrieved; in one test Qwen2.5-7B fell from 74/74 to 33/74, all new errors being the stale answer. Advice: retire or mark superseded memories.
